sources.title: GPT-4 | OpenAI
sources.snippet: GPT‑4‑assisted safety research GPT‑4's advanced reasoning and instruction-following capabilities expedited our safety work. We used GPT‑4 to help create training data for model fine-tuning and iterate on classifiers across training, evaluations, and monitoring.

sources.title: GPT‑4 - OpenAI
sources.snippet: We've created GPT-4, the latest milestone in OpenAI's effort in scaling up deep learning. GPT-4 is a large multimodal model (accepting image and text inputs, emitting text outputs) that, while less capable than humans in many real-world scenarios, exhibits human-level performance on various professional and academic benchmarks.
